title: Incremental CLI updates for labels and criteria
description: Onboarding feedback: replacing entire JSON arrays requires quoting and read-modify-write for small label and acceptance-criterion changes. Investigate narrowly scoped operations; avoid introducing a general patch language.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Add and remove labels and add or update criteria without replacing the entire array in the CLI.
Define unambiguous criterion targeting and duplicate or missing-item behavior; retain validation and revision conflict checks under the lock.
Document and test operations and existing whole-array behavior.

thread.author: product-manager
thread.body: An independent onboarding report corroborates targeted checklist edits: replacing a whole criteria array is cumbersome and risks overwriting unrelated criteria.
